candidate_merges.message: Add React frontend to Go starter template (#21874) ## Description The Go starter now scaffolds a complete Go API and React frontend that works with `aspire run` without additional setup. The frontend waits for the API, uses Aspire-projected endpoint configuration for its Vite proxy, and loads `/api/weatherforecast` on startup.
